name: 2D B-spline Wavelet Masks (Quadtree)
definition: Derivation of 2D masks by convolution of 1D masks in two coordinate directions for quadtree-organized vertices, handling two kinds of new vertices: midpoints of old edges (blue) and centers of old faces (green).
summary: This method defines convolution masks for lifting-based B-spline wavelet transforms on quadtree grids, using linear interpolation to handle missing edge midpoint values and avoiding overshoots.
